pages.name: Sawyer’s Skateboarding Superpets
pages.description: A pixel-art skateboarding game made for my daughter and her pets. Flappy Bird meets endless cartoon hallways, plus a double jump.

pages.name: Da Chicago Pope Hot Dog Dropper Game
pages.description: A Chicago street-food drop game, inspired by the 1995 Mac freeware game Slick Willie 2.0.

pages.name: Wasteland
pages.description: A top-down desert driving game. Hit the gas, drift and fire your guns down Route 66, blasting cacti, TNT and zombies without getting blown to pieces or swallowed by the abyss.

pages.name: Cake Land
pages.description: A top-down, 16-bit style adventure starring Pancake and his bubble wand. Explore the village, fish the Syrup River, collect hats and face Mr. Thunderman.

pages.name: Dice
pages.description: A dice roller for when you don’t have the right dice on hand, with Classic, Vegas and Disco themes.

pages.name: Downhill
pages.description: A pixel-art downhill skiing game: free ski, slalom and freestyle runs, with jumps, tricks and big air. Watch out after 1500 m...

pages.name: Spectrum Studio
pages.description: Turn on your mic for a music-driven visualizer with presets and custom looks, inspired by late-’90s Winamp plugins.

pages.name: Idea Board
pages.description: My own take on Stickies: a corkboard of checklists, photos and links that saves in your browser.

pages.name: Langton’s Ant
pages.description: Two rules, endless surprises. Watch Langton's Ant turn chaos into a highway, with custom grids and up to four ants.
